query:
WITH listed AS (
                           SELECT substr(matched_items.own_id, 1,
                                         instr(matched_items.own_id, '-') - 1) AS namespace,
                                  substr(matched_items.own_id,
                                         instr(matched_items.own_id, '-') + 1) AS value,
                                  matched_items.listed_id, matched_items.season,
                                  matched_items.episode, item_matches.title,
                                  item_matches.show_title, item_matches.genres,
                                  item_matches.content_rating,
                                  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY matched_items.own_id
                                                     ORDER BY matched_items.path) AS version,
                                  MAX(matched_items.added_at)
                                      OVER (PARTITION BY matched_items.own_id) AS newest_added_at
                           FROM (SELECT library_files.library_id, library_items.id AS item_id, library_items.kind,
                      library_files.path, library_items.season, library_items.episode,
                      library_items.added_at, (SELECT substr(MIN(printf('%05d', coalesce(nullif(instr(
                         ',' || libraries.title_sources || ',', ',' || candidate.namespace || ','),
                         0), 99999)) || candidate.namespace || '-' || candidate.value), 6)
              FROM item_match_ids AS candidate
              WHERE candidate.item_id = item_matches.item_id AND candidate.scope = 'title') AS own_id, (SELECT substr(MIN(printf('%05d', coalesce(nullif(instr(
                         ',' || libraries.title_sources || ',', ',' || candidate.namespace || ','),
                         0), 99999)) || candidate.namespace || '-' || candidate.value), 6)
              FROM item_match_ids AS candidate
              WHERE candidate.item_id = item_matches.item_id AND candidate.scope = IIF(library_items.kind = 'movie', 'title', 'show')) AS listed_id
               FROM item_matches
               JOIN library_items ON library_items.id = item_matches.item_id
               JOIN library_files ON library_files.id = library_items.file_id
               JOIN libraries ON libraries.id = library_files.library_id
               WHERE item_matches.state = 'matched'
                 AND library_items.kind = IIF(libraries.kind = 'movies', 'movie', 'episode')
                 AND own_id IS NOT NULL AND listed_id IS NOT NULL
                 AND (library_items.kind = 'movie'
                      OR (library_items.season IS NOT NULL
                          AND library_items.episode IS NOT NULL))) AS matched_items
                           JOIN item_matches ON item_matches.item_id = matched_items.item_id
                           WHERE matched_items.library_id = ?1 AND matched_items.kind = ?2)
                       SELECT namespace AS "namespace!: String", value AS "value!: String",
                              title AS "title!", show_title, season, episode,
                              newest_added_at AS "newest_added_at!: i64",
                              genres, content_rating, listed_id AS "listed_id!: String"
                       FROM listed
                       WHERE version = 1
                         AND (?3 IS NULL
                              OR (namespace, length(value), value) > (?3, length(?4), ?4))
                       ORDER BY namespace, length(value), value
                       LIMIT ?5
